title: Extractive Summarization of Long Documents by Combining Global and Local Context
answer_short: local context: topic segment; global context: whole document
answer_rationale: Text 10 states that local context refers to the topic segment and global context refers to the whole document. Text 6 and Text 8 further support this by describing local context as semantic information within each section and global context as the whole document, respectively.
